changes.comment: The relay ships as a container image you can run on any Docker host behind your own HTTPS proxy: it installs exactly the versions pinned in the repo, runs as an unprivileged user, keeps its data in one volume, and saves everything cleanly when stopped.
The relay answers a health check at /healthz, so a container host or proxy can tell whether it can still read its database.
You can back up the relay's database while it is running, with one command suitable for a nightly job.
